scientific_integrity: Classical coordinate projection, cut feasibility, and linear programming are acknowledged as ingredients; finite checks are not proof; historical priority remains provisional.
scientific_limitations: Intrinsic Euclidean metric of the complete-DAG edge-coordinate realization only; requires n>=3 and strictly positive proper prefix netflows; no claims about degenerate prefix cases, general graphs, other Euclidean embeddings, or independent priority validation.
title: Cut-controlled Euclidean inballs and factorized centers of complete directed flow polytopes
